svg.title: Remote driving
svg.desc: A remote operations centre sends driving commands over a wireless link; they pass through the safety monitor (ASIL D) before reaching the robotaxi. Cards: DQ-010 C, Remote driving in general; SG-08, Do not act on remote driving commands that are stale, corrupted or not the operator's, ASIL C; otherwise vehicle brought to a stop and held, with MON-04 watching the link.

g.text: on the vehicle; drawn apart to show the path
Do not act on remote driving commands that are stale,
vehicle brought to a stop and held; the link's loss or
delay is watched by MON-04 (Remote link)
Remote driving goes through the safety monitor
A remote operator's command is bounded like Autoware's: the monitor checks it, and stops the vehicle if it is stale or not the operator's.
CONCEPT ILLUSTRATION · the safety monitor is not built yet · draft for engineering review
